caption: A cordless drill running on a bench slows and stops as its battery runs flat, and it only twitches when the trigger is pulled again.

sa.check: A cordless drill running on a bench.
No cord runs from the drill.
The order is running, slowing, stopped, trigger pulled, twitch.

pc.expect: The slowing runs one way from running to stopped; the drill does not speed up again on its own.
pc.fail: The drill speeds up again after slowing; or stops and restarts at full speed with nothing touched; or runs faster than before after the stop; or the chuck spins with nothing pulling the trigger after the stop.

pc.expect: When the trigger is pulled again the chuck turns only a little or briefly and stops; it does not run at full speed.
pc.fail: The trigger is pulled again and the drill runs at full speed to the end of the clip; or the twitch grows into steady spinning; or the trigger is pulled and the bit spins while the chuck stays still.

pc.expect: The chuck and bit spin about the drill's axis while running and stay on that axis as they slow.
pc.fail: The bit wobbles off its axis or bends; or the chuck turns while the bit stays still; or the whole drill body spins on the bench.

pc.expect: The drill stays on the bench as it runs and slows, apart from a small shift; it does not walk off.
pc.fail: The drill crawls across the bench and falls; or lifts into the air; or jumps when it stops; or bench items shift at the stop.

pc.expect: One drill with its bit and battery pack; nothing vanishes or passes through the bench.
pc.fail: The bit vanishes or a second bit appears; or the pack detaches and floats; or the drill duplicates; or the bit sinks into the bench.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The drill's colour, its markings and the bench stay the same.
pc.fail: The drill changes colour; or its markings change; or the bench's contents rearrange.

note: The motor's sound is not judged; running and stopping are read from the chuck's visible spin and blur. Who pulls the trigger is not judged.
